The '''V-1 seismic grenade''' was a [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The V-1 seismic grenade appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the types of grenades usable in player-vs-player combat.
